known_limits: Values at masked positions in newly allocated outputs are outside the result-value contract.
Complex inverse-trigonometric results are checked across covered branch cases; bit-for-bit equality across platform libm implementations is not promised.
Floating-error tests cover each flag category and policy plus combined callback flags for supported scalar-kernel results.
NumPy's underflow flag for an exact least-subnormal expm1 or sinh result varies among binary wheels; the differential suite checks these results exactly and treats the flag as non-portable.
Raptors has no ndarray subclasses; subok does not alter results, and third-party dispatch is outside the 0.3 input domain.

differential_cases.platform_conditional_skip_reason: Cases requiring native extended long double are skipped on Darwin arm64, where long double aliases binary64.
